item.title: New JConcepts Pioneer 2.2" Slim 2wd Front Wheel
item.description: The new JConcepts Pioneer slim front wheels for the modern 2wd buggy class have unique features and aesthetics unseen before.

item.title: New Moto-Obscura 10-32 Wheel Nuts
item.description: To complement their 8-32 Aluminum Serrated Wheel Nuts, Moto-Obscura has released a version with 10-32 threads for most vintage Losi vehicles.

item.title: Amain Hobbies and Vanquish Products Announce Exclusive Distribution Agreement
item.description: AMain Hobbies and Vanquish Products announced today an exclusive North American wholesale distribution agreement designed to improve product availability, streamline ordering, and strengthen support for dealers and the rock crawling community.

item.title: 2026 Motorama 1/8th Scale Nationals Results
item.description: Check out the results from the 2026 Motorama 1/8th Scale Nationals held at the famous yearly Harrisburg, Pennsylvania event.

item.title: New Infinity Chrome Plated IF18-3 Transmission Gears
item.description: Infinity has released new IF18-3 precision-machined pinion gears from high-strength 7075-T6 aluminum alloy with a new special hard chrome plating which significantly enhances wear resistance.

item.title: New ProTek RC and Upgrade RC Display Car Stands
item.description: ProTek RC and UpGrade RC are pleased to release a pair of transportable car display stands for use both in your home RC workspace or at the track or local basher park and trails.

item.title: New Team Associated Builders Support Kit 2
item.description: The RC10B6 Builder’s Support Kit 2 brings Team Associated race-winning technology to Builder’s assembling dirt oval sprint cars, late models, and custom drag cars.

item.title: New JConcepts Mono Retro RC10 Wheels
item.description: JConcepts supports the vintage RC enthusiast with the release of new 2.125” Mono front wheels and new 2.0” Mono rear wheels.

item.title: New Team Xray XB8'26 1/8th Nitro Buggy Presentation
item.description: Check out the full presentation for the new 2026 Team Xray XB8 1/8th Scale Nitro Buggy platform.

item.title: New Custom Works Shock Oil, Shock Shafts, Kickup, and Ball Cups
item.description: Custom Works had several new products debuting this past weekend at Motorama that they are excited to tell you about. Find out more here!
